notes.title: Updates 08-05-2023
notes.content:
⌨️ Programming: ⌨️ 
- Hideout Inventory Stash is now implemented: bring your loot home!
- Bicycles are now in our game! Instead of walking everywhere.. Find a bike!
- Stash saving and loading on/offline is implemented
- The character customization has been created: More to follow
- You must bring a generator in your hideout to have power! (psst, get the gasoline too)
- Weapon pickup / wield is implemented, so you can actually shoot something! 😉
- Vehicle plugins/sockets are created so you can put your cars together with the appropriate parts
- Added a post-apocalyptic city package that sincerely gave us a good push in the right direction for the landscape!
- Added hit VFX to zombies when hit/shot and the projectile from the bullets cause damage!
- Improved the current looting system to be more randomized in loot
- Map whiteboard has been implemented! You can draw your favorite loot paths etc on it, or draw places to avoid! 😉

🔧  Hotfixes 🔧 
- Inventory Stash hotfix that wouldn't save the loot transferred
- Item Hotbar hotfix

 Models
Please see the attached photo, as we have been making several models and have edited our zombie model!
- Our landscape is also undertaking some massive design changes & we have sectioned off a great portion for the playtest that everyone can enjoy!

🖼️ UI 🖼️ 
- Speedometer implemented for the vehicles

notes.title: Updates @ 17-03-2023
notes.content:
⌨️ Programming: ⌨️ 
- Footstep audio fix & Footstep leaves print dependent on the type of ground (they fade away after awhile)
- Massive main menu update (see our YouTube for the first leak)
- Skill Tree UI completed! (awaiting the model for it)
- We've added ridable horses!
- Quest system is complete!
- VoIP has been created, with their respected voice ranges & radios!
- Main Menu Credits is implemented, will only have a small window to add any other person!

Models:
- Bunker doors for the hideout complete!
- More power pole variants
- Our first vehicle (GMC Sierra will be completed by the weekend from @suyash_jaiswal_, stay tuned to our Instagram to see it!)

🔗 Socials 🔗 (Discord)
- See our social channels 💬︱important-links If anyone would like to help us out with posts, please DM @Mitral / @JeromeGG 
- Our website is in development from @Mitral, any questions/suggests please message him!

📰 Extras 📰 (Discord)
- If anyone else can help us, we can add your name to the Credits!
- Anyone who would like to help us achieve our goal please DM me @Chameleon, whether it be helping us get our name out there, sharing our information, financially helping us! Thank you in advance!
